header.title: About Us
header.subtitle: A firm built on a standard.

intro: Axenor Corporation S.A.S is a Colombian company specialized in comprehensive technology solutions, based in Bogotá, Colombia. We combine experience, vision and technology to build the digital future of our clients.
mission: To develop high-quality technology solutions through software services, consulting, and technical support, strengthening digital transformation at a national and international level.
vision: To establish ourselves within the next 5 years as leaders in technological innovation, recognized for excellence in software solutions, infrastructure and comprehensive services.

principles.title: Our principles
principles.subtitle: Four principles that govern every engagement.

ownership.title: Owners of the outcome
ownership.text: We take on the whole problem and answer for the final metric, not for billable hours.

proof.title: Proof before claims
proof.text: Every claim is demonstrated with deliverables verifiable against an agreed criterion, not against an opinion.

depth.title: Depth over volume
depth.text: We work with a limited number of clients at a time to sustain the standard in every engagement.

transparency.title: Technical transparency
transparency.text: Documented architecture decisions and continuous visibility of real progress, not a monthly report.

bios.ceo: Leads Axenor's strategic direction and growth vision, building partnerships and new business lines to bring the company's technology solutions to national and international clients.
bios.cto: Responsible for Axenor's technology and security strategy: defines the architecture, engineering standards and cybersecurity posture that sustain solutions in production.
bios.legal: Legal advisor and director at Axenor: structures the legal, contractual and compliance frameworks that back every engagement and protect both clients and the company.
